description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeEducationAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee education records within the OrangeHRM application. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting employee education data, with detailed validation rules and integration with underlying services and data access objects.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationAPI
classes.description: API class providing CRUD operations for employee education records in OrangeHRM, including methods for retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion, with validation and service layer integration.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducationService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and retrieves the EmployeeEducationService instance used for business logic operations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee education record by ID for a given employee, throws exception if not found, and returns the data wrapped in EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employee education records for a specified employee, supporting pagination and sorting, and returns as EndpointCollectionResult.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee education record based on provided input parameters and links it to the specified employee.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee education record identified by ID for the specified employee.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple employee education records based on IDs provided in the request body.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Populates EmployeeEducation entity fields from request parameters and persists it using the DAO layer.
